discovery.SearchPropertyExplorer

SearchPropertyExplorer object provides ability to get search data and metadata by merging responses from two requests.

Available as lseg.data.discovery.SearchPropertyExplorer.

Methods

get_properties_for

Retrieve search data and metadata. Transform results, create properties and navigators objects, merge responses into single object.

get_properties_for(
    query: str = None,
    filter: str = None,
    view: Views | str = Views.SEARCH_ALL,
    order_by: str = None,
    navigators: str = None,
) -> SearchPropertyExplorerResponse

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
query str No None Keyword argument for view.
filter str No None Filter values are boolean predicate expressions that can be defined with help of metadata for building more precise requests.
view Views | str No Views.SEARCH_ALL Picks a subset of the data universe to search against. Default: Views.SEARCH_ALL
order_by str No None Defines the order in which matching documents should be returned.
navigators str No None This can name one or more properties, separated by commas, each of which must be Navigable. It returns supplemental information about the distribution of the whole matched set.

Returns

SearchPropertyExplorerResponse

Example

from lseg.data.discovery import SearchPropertyExplorer
explorer = SearchPropertyExplorer()
santander_bonds = explorer.get_properties_for(
   view=search.Views.GOV_CORP_INSTRUMENTS,
   query="santander bonds",
   filter="IsPerpetualSecurity ne true and IsActive eq true and not(AssetStatus in ('MAT' 'DC'))"
)
